_about: SHA-256 integrity manifest of the calculation contract fixtures (line endings normalized to LF before hashing). The SAME manifest lives in GEOSOLVER.BG/src/domain/geodesy/__fixtures__/ and geosolver-backend/engines/fixtures/; each repo tests its own fixture files against it, and the combined hash is pinned in both test suites. This detects fixture DRIFT at review time — it does not protect calculated floating-point output and is not a network-level cross-repo test. To change a fixture deliberately: edit it in BOTH repos, regenerate this manifest in both, and update the pinned combined hash in both fixtureIntegrity tests.
